https://mastodon.social/@iivoltagewolf@b.text: I played Overgrowth’s story again, and I think I finally have a good grasp of what’s happening. The theme revolves around species superiority, exploitation, and marginalization. The bunnies are the marginalized folk, commonly exploited by other species and forced to fight death matches in arenas. Cats, dogs, rats, and wolves are the oppressors and exploiters. Turner is the Messiah of his kind. Cold, remorseless, and full of desire to live a better life. #overgrowth #furry #videogames
